name: prodlens
description: Looks at a whole web product through one lens: recovers its UI as a graph of screens and transitions, verifies every edge (broken links, dead ends, unreachable screens), plans and executes the critical user journeys, and turns the same walkthrough into a narrated demo with a real cursor.

scripts.diagram:render: cd diagrams && npx remotion render src/export/index.ts SequenceCall out/sequence.mp4 --log=error
scripts.diagram:smoke: cd diagrams && npx remotion render src/export/index.ts SequenceCall out/smoke.mp4 --frames=0-90 --log=error
scripts.diagram:still: cd diagrams && npx remotion still src/export/index.ts StructuralMap out/structural-check.png --log=error
